question: How a folded scalar is re-wrapped after a change

routes.reasoning_given: Inserting or removing a paragraph leaves the others byte-identical; the contract requires re-wrapping. One arm made re-wrapping reordered paragraphs a required fix; another never breaks next to a TAB
routes.route: Align paragraphs with difflib; unchanged paragraphs keep their bytes; changed ones re-wrap at the old width (default 80)
